newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber acquires Phoenix Fiberlink.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber acquires Phoenix Fiberlink.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said siad Monday it acquired the assets of Phoenix Fiberlink in a transaction involving cash and 600,000 shares of Brooks Fiber common stock.
Phoenix Fiberlink provides competitive local telecommunications services in the Salt Lake City, Utah and Reno, Nevada metropolitan markets.
Brooks said it also plans to develop a telecommunications network in Boise, Idaho.

"This acquisition provides us with an outstanding platform for our entry into Salt Lake City, one of the fastest growing cities in the country and a market we have explored for some time," James Allen, chief executive officer, said in a statement.

He added a recently announced expansion of an operating agreement with AT&T Corp T.N to include Salt Lake City allows Brooks Fiber to enter this market with the "assurance of substantial additional revenues."
The Phoenix Fiberlink network in Salt Lake City has over 50 miles of fiber optic cable with an additional 16 miles under construction.
Brooks Fiber provides competitive local telecommunications services, with networks operational or under construction in 37 U.S. cities.
